question_text: A cube net is shown below. The faces have the following symbols: top face has a circle, bottom face has a triangle, left face has a square, right face has a cross, front face has a star, back face has a heart. Which of the following cubes can be formed from this net? (Assume the net is folded inward.)

options.text: A cube with circle on top, star on front, cross on right
A cube with triangle on top, heart on front, square on right
A cube with star on top, circle on front, heart on right
A cube with square on top, cross on front, triangle on right
